PEDDLER.Editor.HelpBody:
Dialogue trees

A tree is a set of nodes joined by choices. A visit starts at the entry node and follows choices until it reaches an End node.

  • Dialogue: the shopkeeper speaks lines, and each choice is a button.
  • Browse: a filtered item grid and the cart.
  • Inventory: the player picks one of their own items into a named variable.
  • Transaction: commits the cart, then branches by outcome.
  • Roll Table and Auto: branch without asking. One choice must carry no condition, as the fallback.
  • Goto: jumps to another node, or to another tree.
  • End: closes the visit.

A choice shows only while its Show When conditions hold, charges whatever sits in Cost, and runs its When Chosen effects once taken.

PEDDLER.Archetype.Blacksmith.Name: The Iron Oath
PEDDLER.Archetype.Blacksmith.Lines.greet: New face. Look all you like, but ask before you touch anything on that wall.
You're back. Knew the edge would bring you round.
Light purse. Mine was too, once. Look anyway.
So, what is it you're after?
PEDDLER.Archetype.Blacksmith.Lines.haggl: I make every piece by hand, and I don't knock coin off just because someone asked.
Ten percent off the wall too, since you'll be spreading my name. And not a word to anyone about what I charged you.
A village smith charges one, and their work bends the first time you swing it.
So it's {fee} now, and the wall costs you a tenth more. That's what the insult buys you.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Blacksmith.Lines.sharp: Sit down. It'll take as long as it takes.
Quiet today, so it's just me and the wheel.
There. Your {{session.vars.honed.name}}, honed sharp. Run your thumb along it, gently now.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Blacksmith.Ambient.bro: All handmade. You're paying for the hours and the steel that went into it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Blacksmith.Lines.no-fu: The wall doesn't move on credit.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Blacksmith.Lines.farew: Look after it and it'll last you.
The wall keeps. I'm not going anywhere.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Blacksmith.Choices.gre: Put an edge on my blade
Put an edge on my blade, as agreed
Put an edge on my blade
{fee} for a whetstone and ten minutes?
PEDDLER.Archetype.Blacksmith.Choices.hag: {fee}, and I'll tell every sellsword on the road who put the edge on it
PEDDLER.Archetype.Apothecary.Name: The Bitter Root
PEDDLER.Archetype.Apothecary.Lines.greet: Hi! Um, welcome, mind the shelves, some of it bites back.
First time? Okay, don't be overwhelmed, it looks like a lot but I'll walk you through it.
Oh, it's you again, {{actor.name}}. Good, I remembered the last one worked.
So, um, what are you after? Are you well? You don't look unwell. Are you unwell?
PEDDLER.Archetype.Apothecary.Lines.intak: Right, tell me where it hurts, or, or what feels wrong, and I'll match it to something.
The master makes it all himself. It actually works, I swear, I have seen it work.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Apothecary.Lines.remed: A fever, okay. Willowbark and the blue draught, and you keep the fluids up, alright?
A wound. Right. Salve first, then the poultice, and please, please change the dressing daily.
Nerves. Yeah. I get that too, honestly. There's a calming tincture, it takes the edge off.
Not sure? That's fine, that's normal, we'll start gentle and see how you feel.
Come on, it's this way, I keep the good stuff where the light doesn't spoil it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Apothecary.Ambient.fla: Anything you're already carrying, um, a bottle, a draught, whatever it is, just hand it here.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Apothecary.Lines.stead: Right, hold still, this bit stains and I have ruined two aprons this week.
Your {{session.vars.flask.name}}, cut with grey root and a thumb of honey so it goes down.
You'll be steady for about an hour. Please don't do anything stupid inside that hour.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Apothecary.Ambient.bro: Everything on this shelf is fresh, um, fresh enough, the dates are on the little tags.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Apothecary.Lines.no-fu: Oh, um, that's a little more than you've got on you, no worries, we can set some aside.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Apothecary.Lines.farew: Great choice, um, take it with food mostly, okay, feel better!
Oh, okay, no worries, come back if it gets worse, or, or better, either way.
Bye! Careful on the step, it wobbles.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Apothecary.Choices.int: I can't sleep, my nerves are shot
PEDDLER.Archetype.Apothecary.Choices.rem: Have you got something stronger for it?
PEDDLER.Archetype.Festival.Name: The Painted Wagon
PEDDLER.Archetype.Festival.Lines.greetin: Fresh, fresh, nothing on this board is stale!
Market day, and my own voice is coming back off the church!
Last hour, love, and I am not carting this lot home again!
Go on, look at the spread. Look at it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Festival.Ambient.stall: Point at whatever takes your fancy, love, I'll have it bagged before you blink.
Enjoy it warm, love, that's how it's meant!
Go on, was there anything else caught your eye?
PEDDLER.Archetype.Festival.Lines.short.0: Save your coppers, duck, that one's dear today.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Festival.Lines.short.1: The day-old's half price and just as sweet.
Oh, you've just missed us, love. Stall's shut.
We're only out when the festival's on, weekends while the light's good.
Find me when the square's loud again and the corner loaf is yours.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Festival.Lines.farewel: Off you pop, love, and no sharing, you earned that!
No bother, love, come back when your belly grumbles!
The smell alone'll bring you back, mark me.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Name: Wandering Wares
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Lines.greeting: Morning to you. I'm here till the sun's high and then I'm not.
New face at the tailboard. Climb up, the dust is worse down there.
You caught me twice. That's rarer than it sounds.
Everything you see has to weigh less by noon. That's my whole problem.
An hour left. I'd sooner sell it cheap than haul it back over the pass.
Light coin is fine by me. Name a number and we'll see what it does.
So. What can I sell you before I'm gone?
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Lines.tales.0: It's a long road and I've walked most of it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Lines.tales.1: The wind carried a few words my way at the last crossing, and I think you might like to hear 'em.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Lines.tales.2: But I don't linger, so don't go looking for me twice in the same place.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Lines.fares.0: There's board space behind the crates if you don't mind the jolting.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Lines.fares.1: I'm going that way regardless. Costs me nothing but the weight.
You caught me once already, and here we both are again.
Same wagon, fresh stock. Take another look.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Lines.charm.0: A little charm for the road, then. Nothing fancy, just something to keep the ruts kind to you.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Lines.charm.1: There. Soft earth under your boots.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Ambient.browse: Trail goods, mostly. Things that earn their weight when you're days from the nearest town.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Lines.no-funds: That's over what you're holding today, friend. Trim it and we'll square up.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Lines.gone.0: The pitch is bare. Flattened grass, a cold fire ring, rope ends in the mud.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Lines.gone.1: He said he'd be gone by noon. He meant it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Lines.gone.2: The ruts point east and they're still sharp at the edges.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Lines.farewell: Thanks for helping keep the wheels turning.
No coin passed, and that's fine. Stop by just to chat next time our paths cross.
Fair winds and clear skies. I'll be down the road by dawn.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Choices.greet-: Have you room for a passenger?
Sell me a bit of luck for the road
Didn't I catch you here before?
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Choices.fw-end: Be gone by morning, then. Take care.
PEDDLER.Archetype.GeneralStore.Name: The Odd Shelf
PEDDLER.Archetype.GeneralStore.Lines.cou: Rope's left. Nails at the back.
Ask if you can't find it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.GeneralStore.Ambient.s: If it works I stock it. Tags are the price.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Tavern.Name: The Adventurers Alcove
Well hello, love! Come in, come in, mind the wet floor by the hearth!
New face, eh? Sit yourself down, I'll pour you something warm.
There you are, {{actor.name}}. Took your time, duck.
You've drunk enough under my roof to count as furniture, you have.
Late one, is it. Fire's banked but there's warmth in it yet.
Now. Drink, a bed, or the news?
PEDDLER.Archetype.Tavern.Lines.rumours.0: They say the old bridge road's washed out again and the caravans are hiring guards. Easy coin, if you've the stomach for mud.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Tavern.Lines.rumours.1: Whole town's uneasy, duck. Folk swear the manor lights burn all night now, and nobody's seen the steward in a fortnight.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Tavern.Lines.rumours.2: Nobody says it above a whisper anymore. What's coming down from the hills isn't bandits, and the garrison knows it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Tavern.Lines.rumours.3: Same as always, love. Somebody owes somebody, somebody's sweet on somebody, and the ale's a copper too dear.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Tavern.Lines.room.0: Your coin's no good tonight. You've paid for that room ten times over.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Tavern.Lines.room.1: Second door on the left, love. Fresh straw, and the window latches if you jiggle it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Tavern.Lines.room.2: Sleep soft. I'll not have anyone up those stairs that shouldn't be.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Tavern.Ambient.browse: Ale, wine, a bite of what's on the fire. Point at what you fancy, duck.
Your purse won't cover that one, love. Pick something kinder.
Use it well, duck. And come back thirsty.
Door's where you left it, love.
Keep your head down out there.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Name: The Secondhand Patron
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Lines.greeti: A new face, and how delightful. Browse, browse, the good pieces reward a slow eye.
Ah, {{actor.name}}. Returned to good taste, I see.
Do keep the coppers well away from the sapphires, darling. They sulk.
Now. Whatever your eye lands on, it has excellent judgment. What can I show you?
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Choices.case: Take my training in the arcane. I'll take the relic.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Choices.gree: Show me what the glass is hiding.
I have something for you to look at
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Ambient.brow: Every piece here is charmed, warded, or worse. Do mind which is which.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Lines.locked: The glass doesn't open for coin, darling. Name what you want, then tell me what you'll stop knowing.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Relic.Name: The Secondhand Patron's Relic
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Relic.Descri: Bought from the case with something that used to be knowledge.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Ambient.lock: These would embarrass the shelves, so they live behind glass. Touch the velvet. Leave the glass alone.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Lines.no-fun: Oh, sweet thing. That one is rather beyond us today. Choose again, and choose smaller.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Lines.apprai: You brought me something. How thrilling.
Set it on the velvet and take your hand well away. Let the glass do the talking.
A trifling fee for my eye, of course. Nothing that isn't worth it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Choices.appr: Go on, then. Have your look.
On second thought, keep your fee.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Lines.apprai: The glass sings for it, and it never flatters. This is genuine, and worth a good deal more than whoever sold it to you let on.
You have an eye. That's what the case opens for, and not for many.
The glass stays quiet, and I won't lie to you to fill the silence. It might be enchanted, it might be a very convincing paperweight.
Bring it back when the moon turns and I'll look again.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Lines.farewe: Wear it in the best of health, darling.
Your taste will catch up to your eye. Give it a decade.
Take all the time you like deciding. I'll be here.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Name: The Tome of Tomes
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Lines.greet: Oh. Hello. Some weather we're having, isn't it.
Welcome to the Tome of Tomes. I don't think I've seen you in before, so just shout if a spine catches your eye.
Good to see you again. Back for something in particular, or just after the smell of old paper?
Three commissions in my ledger under your name. I'd say we're past small talk.
No rush on coin. Half my regulars only ever come to read the spines, so you're in good company.
So. What sort of thing are you chasing today? You can just tell me, if it helps.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Choices.gre: Back for the usual, if you have it
Could you copy a book for me?
Not sure what I want, honestly
Let me just tell you what I'm after…
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Ambient.boo: Take your time. Everything worth reading is a little out of order on purpose.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Lines.no-fu: Ah. That sits outside today's arithmetic, I'm afraid. Set it down gently and we'll try a humbler shelf.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Lines.commi: Ah, a commission. Now that's my favorite kind of afternoon.
Every page by hand, mind, so it takes what it takes. The price is the hours and the ink.
Leave me the title and come back in a few days. I do good work when nobody rushes me.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Choices.com: I'll leave the title with you.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Lines.colle: It is, yes. Bound it in calf, I hope that suits, the goat stock had a smell to it.
Take it away before I start reading it again and decide to keep it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Lines.lore-: Histories, good choice. People call them dry, but a decent chronicle is just gossip that outlived everyone in it.
I keep the town annals in the back, sorted by which magistrate was lying that decade.
Two of them the council would rather I had burned. I did not burn them.
Keep your voice exactly where it is.
One is a tithe ledger from the bad winter. It lists what the manor took and, further down, who starved.
The other is a marriage record that makes entirely the wrong man an heir.
I won't sell you either one. But you know they exist now, and that cost you nothing.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Choices.ban: Show me what you will sell.
I didn't hear any of that.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Lines.lore-: Arcana. Careful with that shelf, some of these I keep behind glass for a reason.
I can't cast a lick myself, but I can tell you which of them won't singe your eyebrows off. That counts as a service.
Hm. Not sure I've got exactly that. But I've got a lot, and I'm terrible at throwing things out, so we might have something close.
Give me the subject and a minute, and I'll go rummaging.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Lines.farew: Thank you, truly. I hope it treats you well.
Keep me in mind if you're ever after a good read. Or a bad one, I have those too.
The door sticks. Put a shoulder in it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Name: The Muddy Hoof
Ain't seen your face round here before. Watch your boots, the yard's a mite muddy.
Well hey there, {{actor.name}}! Back for another look?
Third horse off this yard for you now. Folks'll start thinking I'm your uncle.
Come on in and take a wander. Every one of 'em's sound in wind and limb, I'll swear to it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Ambient.mounts: Take your time picking. You'll be spending a lot of miles with whichever one you take.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Lines.short.0: Whoa now. That's more horse than you're holding.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Lines.short.1: Happens to everyone. The plainer stock carries you the same distance.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Lines.tack-intr: Now, a bare back'll do you no favors past the first mile.
You bought the horse off me, so the leather goes to you at cost. That's how I do it.
While you're here, cast an eye over the tack. Good leather saves you a sore seat.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Ambient.tack: Oiled and mended, every strap of it. I don't hang anything here I wouldn't ride out on myself.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Lines.tack-shor: That's dearer than you want. Take the plain set and ride happy.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Lines.board.0: Now she's yours, where's she laying her head tonight?
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Lines.board.1: I've got a warm stall going spare. {fee} a night, hay and a rubdown thrown in.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Lines.board.2: Beats leaving her tied to a post in the cold, don't it?
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Lines.confirm.0: She'll be waiting in the stall come morning, fed and brushed. You've my word.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Lines.confirm.1: That's you all squared away, then.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Lines.confirm.2: No harm done, come see me when you're in the market for a good horse.
Suit yourself. The gate's always open.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Lines.fares.0: Not looking to own one, just to get somewhere? I run horses out to a few places.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Lines.fares.1: Say the word and one of my lads takes the reins. You just hold on.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Name: The Cloak and Barter
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Lines.greeting.1: New face. Faces are a risk in here.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Lines.prove.0: You want in deeper. Everyone does.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Lines.prove.1: Coin first. Then I show you the good shelf.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Lines.trust-up.1: Don't make me regret the ink.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Ambient.browse: Front-of-stall stock, nothing that'll get either of us hanged. Look, don't finger it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Ambient.browse-f: The quiet stock. Every piece has a story and a price. You never saw where it came from.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Ambient.unload: Lay it on the cloth. I don't ask, you don't tell.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Lines.took-it.0: Gone by morning. The story with it.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Lines.took-it.1: You've a better name in here now.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Lines.no-funds.0: Wrong price bracket. Set it down.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Lines.farewell.1: Lane's that way. Walk it separate.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Choices.greet-pr: How do I earn a real look?
PEDDLER.Archetype.Blacksmith.Ambient.sha: Right, which one am I honing? Set it on the block.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Blacksmith.Blurb: A blunt, proud smith. Haggle her sharpening fee in dialogue, then pick the blade she puts an edge on.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Apothecary.Blurb: An anxious apprentice who never stops talking. Answer what ails you, then hand her a flask to fortify.
PEDDLER.Archetype.GeneralStore.Blurb: A shopkeeper of few words. The smallest tree, with a counter and shelves.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Tavern.Blurb: A warm innkeeper. Rumours track your campaign's act, and a long tab earns a free bed.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Blurb: A theatrical dealer. Roll a table to appraise what you brought, and the locked case opens if it is genuine.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Blurb: A scribe who rambles. Type what you are after, and he keeps a ledger of your commissions.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Blurb: A folksy horse-trader. Buy a mount first, then tack at cost, then board.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Blurb: A wary receiver. Climb three rungs of trust, then sell him what you would rather not explain.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Festival.Blurb: A crier who barks the same pitch every time. Open only on market days.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Blurb: A trader gone by noon. He counters your offer if you haggle, and the pitch is empty after.

PEDDLER.Sheet.FlavorLinePlaceholder: Good pick. That one moves fast.
That's a company's worth of edge.
Either you're arming a war band or you're frightened. Neither's my business.
Mind the stopper on that one, it's a bad seal.
Two drops. Two. Not a mouthful.
Keep it out of the sun or it turns cloudy and useless.
Oh, good, that one actually works, I've seen it work.
Shake it first. Sorry. Shake it first, I always forget to say.
That's the last of that batch, so, um, no pressure.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Apothecary.Flavor.remo: Wise, honestly, it doesn't keep past the month.
Back in the rack, no bother.
Was it the smell? It's usually the smell.
Okay. Okay. We'll find something better.
That's a lot of bandaging for one person.
You're stocking for something bad, aren't you. You don't have to tell me.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Tavern.Flavor.add.3: On the fire since noon, that has.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Tavern.Flavor.big.0: You're settling in for the night, I see.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Flavor.add.0: Oh, that one's been watching you back.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Flavor.remov: It'll keep, darling. Nothing here is in a hurry.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Flavor.big.1: You're going to need a bigger bag, darling, and possibly a lawyer.
PEDDLER.Archetype.MagicShop.Flavor.big.2: At this point I should ask what you intend. I shan't, but I should.
A fine edition. Handle it by the boards, not the spine.
That one has been sat there waiting for somebody for eleven years.
Careful, the ink on that plate never fully took.
Oh, the marginalia in that one is better than the text.
Its previous owner disagreed with the author. Loudly. In pencil.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Bookseller.Flavor.remo: It wasn't for you. No shame in that.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Flavor.add.2: Check the girth before you ride out.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Flavor.remove.1: Nothing wrong with second thoughts round a horse.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Flavor.remove.2: She'd not have liked you anyway.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Flavor.big.0: That's half my yard walking out the gate.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Stable.Tack.Flavor.add: Good leather. Your backside will thank me.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Fence.Flavor.big.0: That's a lot of trouble in one bundle.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Festival.Flavor.add.1: Oh, that one's lucky, that is.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Festival.Flavor.add.2: Off the wagon this morning, still warm!
PEDDLER.Archetype.Festival.Flavor.add.3: Good eye on you, love, good eye!
PEDDLER.Archetype.Festival.Flavor.big.0: Look at the arms on you, carrying all that!
PEDDLER.Archetype.Festival.Flavor.big.1: You'll not get that lot home without eating half!
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Flavor.add.0: Carried that over two passes. It can carry itself now.
PEDDLER.Archetype.Caravan.Flavor.add.1: You'll want that before the border.

That's more for me to haul.
You're breaking my heart and my axle.
Suit yourself. It goes over the pass with me.
I'd have gone lower on that, you know.
